name: Hard-coded File Paths
description: Absolute file paths prevent containerization and cloud deployment where file systems are ephemeral
remediation: Use environment variables, classpath resources, or cloud configuration services instead of absolute paths
impact: Hard-coded paths prevent containerization and cloud deployment where file systems are ephemeral and paths differ across environments

name: Local File System Write Operations
description: Writing to local file system violates cloud storage patterns and causes data loss in containers
remediation: Replace local file writes with cloud storage services (S3, Blob Storage) or external databases
impact: Local file writes cause data loss in ephemeral containers and violate cloud-native stateless architecture principles

name: Java.io.File Usage for Data Storage
description: Using File API for persistent data storage instead of cloud storage services
remediation: Replace File API with cloud storage SDKs (AWS S3, Azure Blob, GCP Cloud Storage) or databases for persistent data
impact: File API creates local state that's lost in ephemeral containers and doesn't scale across distributed cloud environments

name: Local Directory Scanning
description: Scanning local directories assumes persistent file system
remediation: Replace directory scanning with cloud storage listing APIs (S3 ListObjects, Azure Blob List) or metadata databases
impact: Local directory scanning fails in ephemeral containers where directories don't persist and assumes fixed file system structure

name: HTTP Session State Storage
description: Storing application state in HTTP sessions prevents horizontal scaling
remediation: Use external session stores (Redis, database) or stateless design with JWT tokens
impact: In-memory sessions prevent horizontal scaling and fail in distributed cloud environments

name: Static Mutable Variables
description: Static variables holding state prevent proper scaling and cause issues in distributed environments
remediation: Replace with distributed caches (Redis, Hazelcast) or database storage
impact: Static state creates shared memory issues across instances and breaks in containerized environments

name: In-Memory Caching Without TTL
description: Local caches without expiration cause memory issues and inconsistency across instances
remediation: Use distributed caching solutions with TTL (Redis, Caffeine with expiration)
impact: Unbounded caches cause memory leaks and data inconsistency in multi-instance deployments

name: Singleton Pattern with State
description: Stateful singletons break in multi-instance deployments
remediation: Use dependency injection with stateless services and external state storage
impact: Stateful singletons break when multiple instances run, causing data loss and inconsistency

name: Hard-coded Database Credentials
description: Credentials in code prevent environment-specific configuration
remediation: Use environment variables or external configuration management (Spring profiles, HashiCorp Vault)
impact: Hardcoded credentials create security vulnerabilities and prevent environment-specific deployments

name: Properties Files in Classpath
description: Configuration files packaged with application prevent runtime changes
remediation: Use external configuration sources (environment variables, config servers, mounted volumes)
impact: Classpath configs require rebuilds for changes and prevent environment-specific configurations

name: Hard-coded Environment URLs
description: Environment-specific URLs prevent portability
remediation: Use environment variables or service discovery mechanisms
impact: Hard-coded URLs break when services move between environments or use dynamic addressing

name: XML Configuration Files
description: XML-based configuration (Spring XML, web.xml) harder to override in cloud
remediation: Migrate to annotation-based configuration or externalized YAML/properties with profiles
impact: XML configs are harder to override at runtime and don't support dynamic environment-specific values

name: Direct JDBC Connections
description: Managing database connections directly prevents cloud connection pooling
remediation: Use connection pooling frameworks (HikariCP, Spring Boot DataSource) or cloud database proxies
impact: Direct connections exhaust database limits and prevent efficient resource utilization in cloud environments

name: Database-Specific SQL
description: Vendor-specific SQL prevents database portability in cloud
remediation: Use JPA/Hibernate with database-agnostic queries or ORM query builders
impact: Vendor-specific SQL prevents migration between cloud database services and multi-cloud strategies

name: Stored Procedure Dependencies
description: Heavy reliance on stored procedures limits cloud database options
remediation: Move business logic to application layer or use cloud-native functions
impact: Stored procedures limit database portability and are incompatible with serverless architectures

name: Two-Phase Commit Transactions
description: Distributed transactions don't work well in cloud environments
remediation: Use saga pattern, eventual consistency, or compensating transactions
impact: Distributed transactions frequently fail due to network partitions and timeouts in cloud environments

name: Hard-coded Ports
description: Fixed port numbers prevent dynamic port assignment in containers
remediation: Use environment variables or system property injection for port configuration
impact: Fixed ports cause deployment conflicts and prevent dynamic orchestration in containerized environments

name: RMI Usage
description: Java RMI doesn't work well through cloud load balancers
remediation: Replace with REST APIs, gRPC, or message queues for service communication
impact: RMI fails through cloud load balancers and firewalls due to dynamic port allocation requirements

name: Direct Socket Programming
description: Low-level socket programming bypasses cloud networking features
remediation: Use HTTP clients, message queues, or cloud SDK communication libraries
impact: Raw sockets bypass load balancers, service discovery, and cloud networking features like security groups

name: Multicast Dependencies
description: IP multicast doesn't work in most cloud environments
remediation: Replace with message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka) or pub-sub cloud services
impact: IP multicast is blocked by cloud network infrastructure and doesn't work across availability zones

name: Unbounded Thread Creation
description: Creating threads without limits causes resource exhaustion
remediation: Use thread pools (ExecutorService, CompletableFuture) with bounded capacity
impact: Unlimited threads exhaust memory and CPU resources, causing application crashes in resource-constrained cloud environments

name: Custom Thread Pools
description: Hard-coded thread pool sizes don't adapt to cloud resources
remediation: Use dynamic thread pools based on available CPU cores or cloud-managed thread pools
impact: Fixed thread counts don't scale with varying cloud instance sizes and resource allocations

name: Thread Local Storage
description: ThreadLocal variables cause memory leaks in cloud app servers
remediation: Use request-scoped beans, dependency injection, or pass context explicitly through method parameters
impact: ThreadLocal variables cause memory leaks in long-running cloud applications when not properly cleaned up

name: Scheduled Tasks with Fixed Delay
description: Local scheduled tasks don't work in multi-instance deployments
remediation: Use distributed scheduling solutions (Quartz with database, cloud cron services) or leader election patterns
impact: Local scheduled tasks run on every instance causing duplicate execution and resource conflicts

name: EJB 2.x Usage
description: Older EJB versions have heavy container dependencies
remediation: Upgrade to Jakarta EE 10+ with EJB 4+ or migrate to Spring Boot
impact: EJB 2.x requires heavy application servers and lacks modern cloud-native features

name: Struts 1.x Framework
description: Legacy Struts versions have security and cloud compatibility issues
remediation: Migrate to Spring Boot with Spring MVC or modern Jakarta EE frameworks
impact: Struts 1.x has known security vulnerabilities and lacks cloud-native features like auto-configuration and embedded servers

name: Spring Versions < 4.0
description: Older Spring versions lack cloud-native features
remediation: Upgrade to Spring Boot 3.x+ with annotation-based configuration and cloud starter dependencies
impact: Pre-4.0 Spring lacks cloud-native features like auto-configuration, embedded servers, and cloud integration support

name: Java Versions < 8
description: Older Java versions lack cloud-friendly features and support
remediation: Upgrade to latest Java (17/21)
impact: Pre-Java 8 lacks lambda expressions, streaming APIs, container awareness, and security updates required for cloud deployments

name: Custom Session Management
description: Rolling your own session management breaks cloud load balancing
remediation: Use stateless JWT tokens or externalized session stores (Redis, Spring Session)
impact: Custom session management breaks load balancing across multiple instances causing session loss and user logouts

name: File-based Authentication
description: Storing credentials in local files doesn't scale
remediation: Use cloud IAM services (AWS Cognito, Azure AD) or centralized identity providers (LDAP, OAuth)
impact: File-based credentials create security risks and don't scale across multiple instances or provide centralized management

name: IP-based Security
description: IP whitelisting doesn't work with dynamic cloud IPs
remediation: Use cloud security groups, network ACLs, or application-level authentication instead of IP-based restrictions
impact: IP-based security fails with dynamic cloud IPs and doesn't work with load balancers and CDNs

name: Hard-coded Certificates
description: Certificates in code prevent rotation and environment separation
remediation: Use cloud certificate management services (AWS ACM, Azure Key Vault) or external certificate stores
impact: Hard-coded certificates prevent certificate rotation and create security vulnerabilities

name: File-based Logging
description: Logging to files loses logs in ephemeral containers
remediation: Use cloud logging services (CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Stackdriver) or centralized log aggregation
impact: File-based logging loses logs when containers restart and doesn't support distributed log analysis

name: Custom Log Formats
description: Non-standard log formats prevent cloud log aggregation
remediation: Use structured logging with standard formats (JSON, logback, log4j2) for cloud log aggregation
impact: Custom log formats prevent effective log parsing and analysis in cloud monitoring systems

name: Missing Correlation IDs
description: Lack of trace correlation makes debugging distributed systems hard
remediation: Implement distributed tracing with correlation IDs (Spring Cloud Sleuth, OpenTelemetry) for request tracking
impact: Missing correlation IDs make it difficult to trace requests across distributed cloud services

name: Unbounded Collections
description: Collections without size limits cause memory issues
remediation: Use bounded collections with size limits or streaming processing for large datasets
impact: Unbounded collections cause memory exhaustion in cloud environments with limited resources

name: Missing Connection Timeouts
description: Connections without timeouts hang in cloud networks
remediation: Set appropriate connection and read timeouts for all network connections
impact: Missing timeouts cause applications to hang indefinitely in cloud network environments

name: Resource Leaks
description: Unclosed resources exhaust cloud container limits
remediation: Use try-with-resources statements or ensure proper resource cleanup in finally blocks
impact: Resource leaks exhaust cloud container memory and file handle limits

name: Synchronous Blocking Operations
description: Blocking I/O reduces cloud application throughput
remediation: Use reactive programming (WebFlux, CompletableFuture) or async I/O for better cloud scalability
impact: Blocking operations reduce application throughput and scalability in cloud environments

name: AWS SDK v1 Usage
description: AWS SDK v1 lacks async support needed for Lambda
remediation: Upgrade to AWS SDK v2 with async support and better cloud-native features
impact: AWS SDK v1 lacks async support required for serverless and cloud-native applications

name: Azure Storage SDK < v12
description: Older Azure SDKs lack cloud-native features
remediation: Upgrade to Azure Storage SDK v12+ with modern async APIs and cloud-native features
impact: Older Azure SDKs lack modern async support and cloud-native integration features

name: GCP Client Libraries < 1.0
description: Beta GCP libraries may have breaking changes
remediation: Upgrade to stable GCP client libraries v1.0+ to avoid breaking changes
impact: Beta GCP libraries may have breaking changes and lack production stability guarantees

name: JMS Queue Dependencies
description: Traditional JMS doesn't map well to cloud messaging
remediation: Replace with cloud-native messaging services (AWS SQS, Azure Service Bus, Google Pub/Sub)
impact: Traditional JMS doesn't integrate well with cloud messaging services and lacks cloud-native features

name: Long Startup Times
description: Slow initialization delays cloud scaling and health checks
remediation: Optimize startup time, use lazy initialization, and implement health checks for cloud readiness
impact: Long startup times delay cloud scaling and cause health check failures in containerized environments

name: Static Initializers with I/O
description: I/O in static blocks fails in cloud environments
remediation: Move I/O operations to lazy initialization or dependency injection
impact: Static I/O operations fail in cloud environments where file systems may not be available at startup

name: Eager Loading of Data
description: Loading all data at startup doesn't scale
remediation: Use lazy loading, pagination, or on-demand data loading for better cloud scalability
impact: Eager data loading consumes excessive memory and slows startup in cloud environments

name: WAR Packaging
description: WAR files assume app server, while cloud prefers executable JARs
remediation: Convert to executable JAR with embedded server for cloud-native deployment
impact: WAR packaging requires external application servers and doesn't align with cloud-native container patterns

name: Native Libraries
description: JNI/Native dependencies break container portability
remediation: Replace native libraries with pure Java alternatives or use multi-stage container builds
impact: Native libraries break container portability and cause deployment issues across different cloud platforms

name: Platform-Specific Code
description: OS-specific code breaks cloud portability
remediation: Use cross-platform Java APIs and avoid OS-specific code for cloud portability
impact: Platform-specific code prevents deployment across different cloud platforms and operating systems

name: Large Application Size
description: Apps > 250MB slow down cloud deployments
remediation: Optimize application size, use multi-stage builds, and implement efficient packaging strategies
impact: Large application sizes slow down cloud deployments and increase resource consumption
